name: Speedtrap
description: Coalesced stale-response handling: discard, reinject, or buffer overlapping agent responses when a channel moves during processing.

assumeUnknownToolsAreWrites.label: Unknown Tools = Writes
assumeUnknownToolsAreWrites.help: When true, unrecognized tools are assumed to have write side effects. This forces delivery for unknown tool calls, which is safer than silently discarding. Default: true

debug.label: Debug Logging
debug.help: Log all Speedtrap decisions to console

coalesce.label: Coalescing
coalesce.help: Enable coalesced stale-response handling: buffer overlapping inbounds, reinject with follow-up context. Default: false

claimWhileActive.label: Claim While Active
claimWhileActive.help: Claim overlapping inbound messages via inbound_claim while a run is active, preventing fan-out. Requires coalesce=true. Default: false

maxBufferedMessages.label: Max Buffered Messages
maxBufferedMessages.help: Maximum pending inbound messages buffered per channel. Ring buffer: oldest dropped when full. Default: 20

pendingTtlMs.label: Pending TTL (ms)
pendingTtlMs.help: TTL for pending buffer entries in milliseconds. Expired entries are pruned. Default: 900000 (15 min)

maxReinjects.label: Max Reinjects
maxReinjects.help: Maximum reinject attempts before forcing delivery. Fail-safe to avoid loop starvation. Default: 3
